title: Black & Pink National current first-party homepage
summary: Current Black & Pink National homepage identifies the national organization and states it has a grassroots network of 11 volunteer-led chapters.

data.notes: Current homepage states Black & Pink National is based in Omaha and has a grassroots network of 11 volunteer-led chapters. This pass does not infer the eight chapters not exposed by the current chapter navigation.

title: Black & Pink National current chapter directory
summary: Current first-party chapter directory describes Black & Pink chapters as volunteer-led and exposes Southern Colorado, Missoula, and Providence chapter pages in live navigation.

data.notes: Live chapter navigation exposes Southern Colorado, Missoula, and Providence. The homepage says 11 chapters exist nationally, but this pass records only currently exposed named chapters.

title: Black & Pink Southern Colorado current first-party chapter page
summary: Current Black & Pink National chapter page identifies the Southern Colorado entry as the Denver Chapter formed in 2015 and publishes a chapter email.

data.notes: Page is titled Southern Colorado; body says 'The Denver Chapter of Black & Pink formed in 2015' and publishes denver@blackandpink.org.

title: Southern Colorado Black & Pink current first-party site
summary: Current Southern Colorado Black & Pink site remains active and publishes southerncolorado@blackandpink.org.

data.notes: Current first-party site provides active contact surface southerncolorado@blackandpink.org.

title: Black & Pink Missoula current first-party chapter page
summary: Current Black & Pink National chapter page identifies the Missoula Chapter formed in 2018 and publishes missoulablackandpink@gmail.com.

data.notes: Current first-party page describes Missoula as a Black & Pink chapter and publishes missoulablackandpink@gmail.com.

title: Black & Pink Providence current first-party chapter page
summary: Current Black & Pink National chapter page identifies Black & Pink Providence, describes current recurring meetings, and publishes providence@blackandpink.org.

data.notes: Current page describes chapter mission and recurring meetings with providence@blackandpink.org.

title: Black & Pink National release on Massachusetts independence
summary: Black & Pink National's 2020 release states Black and Pink Massachusetts, formerly Black & Pink Boston, became an independent entity from the national organization.

data.notes: December 11, 2020 release says Black and Pink Massachusetts was formerly Black & Pink Boston and a member of the nationwide chapter network, and became an independent entity from Black & Pink National.

title: Black and Pink Massachusetts Coalition current first-party site
summary: Current Black and Pink Massachusetts Coalition site self-identifies BPMC as a separate Massachusetts 501(c)(3) advocacy organization and publishes public contact and Facebook identifiers.

data.notes: Current site self-identifies Black and Pink Massachusetts Coalition Inc. (BPMC) as a 501(c)(3), publishes admin@bpmcoalition.com and Facebook identifier blackandpinkmassachusettscoalitioninc. Treat separately from Black and Pink Massachusetts.

title: Prison Activist Resource Center current Black & Pink directory entry
summary: Current Prison Activist Resource Center directory lists Black & Pink National and exact public Facebook and Instagram endpoints.

data.notes: Current directory lists Facebook https://www.facebook.com/blackandpinknational and Instagram https://www.instagram.com/blackandpinkorg/ for Black & Pink National.
